_about: A sample of world/members.json for developing and checking the contact box. All records but X000000 are copied from unitedstates/congress-legislators (CC0, legislators-current, read 2026-10-10), including the mistyped contact_form of F000484, which the app must refuse. X000000 is made up, so that the mailto path has something to run on: no such member, address or number exists.
